inspections.notes: Vibration slightly elevated (3.8 mm/s). Scheduled monitoring.
Check valve spring slack noted; replaced.

nodes.description: Loud popping, crackling, or gravel-in-casing noise accompanied by erratic suction pressure.

nodes.name: Mechanical Seal Fluid Leakage

nodes.name: High Motor Bearing Temperature

nodes.name: Discharge Pressure Pulsation

nodes.name: Low Discharge Flow Rate

blue sparks seen in terminal head

aliases: loud metallic screech then sudden lockup

nodes.description: Lube oil sight glass displays milky, cloudy, or frothy fluid appearance.

nodes.title: Emergency Electrical Isolation & Lockout/Tagout (LOTO)
safety_precautions: Wear minimum 8 cal/cm2 Arc Flash PPE and Class 0 insulated gloves
Verify absence of voltage using an approved, calibrated contact probe before touching terminals
stop_work_conditions: Visible smoke or active electrical arcing
Burning electrical odor or molten conductor evidence
Sudden mechanical seizure with stalled energized rotor

steps.instruction: Immediately depress Emergency Stop pushbutton at local control station.
steps.expected_observation: Motor de-energizes and indicator light turns red/tripped.
steps.caution: Do not stand directly in front of starter cabinet during emergency trip.

steps.instruction: Open motor circuit breaker in MCC-415 and attach personal red safety padlock and danger tag.
steps.expected_observation: Breaker handle locked in positive open position.

steps.instruction: Perform live-dead-live zero voltage verification at motor terminal junction box.
steps.expected_observation: 0.0 VAC across all phase pairs L1-L2, L2-L3, L3-L1 and to ground.

steps.instruction: Escalate fault report immediately to Plant Electrical Supervisor.
steps.expected_observation: Supervisor signs handover log.

nodes.escalation_criteria: Any indication of arc flash, phase-to-ground flashover, or smoke requires supervisor sign-off before breaker re-closure.

nodes.title: Precision Dial-Indicator Bearing Clearance & Runout Verification
safety_precautions: Confirm asset is locked out and depressurized before mounting dial indicators
Wear safety glasses and cut-resistant gloves
stop_work_conditions: Shaft cannot be rotated by hand (locked/seized)
Severe metal shavings found inside bearing cavity

steps.instruction: Mount magnetic base dial indicator on pump bearing bracket with stylus perpendicular to shaft journal.
steps.expected_observation: Indicator zeroed cleanly at 12 o'clock position.

steps.instruction: Using a wooden pry bar, apply gentle upward radial force (approx 30 kg) and record total indicator reading (TIR).
steps.expected_observation: Radial clearance reading between 0.025 mm and 0.038 mm.
steps.caution: Do not exceed 50 kg leverage to avoid brinelling race.

steps.instruction: Compare measured TIR to maximum allowable tolerance of 0.038 mm (note: obsolete Rev A allowed 0.080 mm).
steps.expected_observation: If TIR > 0.038 mm, bearing replacement is mandated.

nodes.escalation_criteria: If radial play exceeds 0.050 mm or axial float exceeds 0.12 mm, issue replacement work order.

nodes.title: Suction Strainer Inspection & Available NPSH Verification
safety_precautions: Close suction block valve and vent basket strainer cavity to atmosphere before unbolting cover
Ensure drain valve discharge is directed to industrial drain sump
stop_work_conditions: Hazardous chemical fumes escaping from strainer drain
Suction block valve passing (will not achieve zero differential pressure)

steps.instruction: Observe differential pressure gauge across duplex suction strainer basket.
steps.expected_observation: Differential pressure Delta-P < 0.25 bar. If Delta-P > 0.5 bar, strainer is choked.

steps.instruction: Switch to standby basket or depressurize and remove strainer screen for inspection.
steps.expected_observation: Clean 40-mesh stainless screen free of scale and polymer buildup.

steps.instruction: Verify suction static pressure gauge reading exceeds minimum 1.20 bar gauge while running.
steps.expected_observation: Stable suction pressure > 1.20 barg without fluctuation.

nodes.escalation_criteria: If clean strainer still yields suction pressure < 1.0 bar gauge, check suction line foot valve or supply vessel blanketing.

nodes.title: Mechanical Seal API Plan 11 Flush & Barrier System Check
safety_precautions: Wear face shield and acid/chemical resistant gloves when inspecting seal drain area
Do not place fingers near rotating shaft collar
stop_work_conditions: Continuous steady fluid stream (> 100 ml/min) pouring from gland plate
Active vapor plume escaping seal cavity

steps.instruction: Touch Plan 11 flush recirculation line 50 mm upstream of gland inlet to test temperature.
steps.expected_observation: Line should feel warm (approx 40-50°C), confirming active fluid flow.

steps.instruction: Inspect Plan 11 orifice union for particulate blockage or crystallization.
steps.expected_observation: Orifice port clear; no crystallized salt or scale.

steps.instruction: Measure leakage rate at gland drain port over 5 minutes with graduated cylinder.
steps.expected_observation: Normal seepage < 3 drops per minute. Liquid pooling indicates face damage.

nodes.escalation_criteria: Leakage exceeding 15 drops/min requires scheduled cartridge seal replacement.

nodes.title: Dynamic Laser Shaft Alignment (Pump to Motor)
safety_precautions: Confirm LOTO is applied to motor main breaker
Remove coupling guard only after locking out
stop_work_conditions: Motor hold-down bolt sheared or stripped thread in baseplate
Severe soft foot (> 0.20 mm) that cannot be shimmed

steps.instruction: Mount laser emitter and receiver on pump and motor shaft hubs.
steps.expected_observation: Laser beams centered in target detectors.

steps.instruction: Execute soft foot test by loosening each motor foot bolt one by one.
steps.expected_observation: Deflection under each foot < 0.05 mm.

steps.instruction: Rotate shafts 360 degrees and adjust stainless steel shims under motor feet.
steps.expected_observation: Final angular misalignment < 0.05 mm/100mm, parallel offset < 0.03 mm.

nodes.escalation_criteria: If coupling hubs show fretting corrosion or elastomer insert is shredded, replace coupling insert before realignment.

nodes.title: ApexFlow CP-200 Impeller Acoustic Resonance & Bypass Check
safety_precautions: Ensure discharge pressure dampener is rated for 25 bar design pressure
Do not close minimum flow bypass line during testing
stop_work_conditions: Piping discharge hanger visibly bending or pipe clamp weld cracked

steps.instruction: Verify minimum continuous flow bypass valve position on ApexFlow CP-200.
steps.expected_observation: Bypass valve indicated open at >= 35% stroke when main discharge throttled.

steps.instruction: Connect high-frequency pressure transducer to discharge piezometer ring.
steps.expected_observation: Pressure pulsation amplitude < 0.8 bar peak-to-peak at 5x running speed.

nodes.escalation_criteria: If pulsation persists > 1.5 bar peak-to-peak at full flow, inspect impeller tip vane clearance.

nodes.title: ApexFlow CP-100 Discharge Check Valve Pin & Spring Inspection
safety_precautions: Isolate discharge block valve and depressurize check valve spool piece
Tag discharge line as pressurized hazard before unbolting bonnet
stop_work_conditions: Liquid weeping past discharge block valve when vented

steps.instruction: Unbolt bonnet plate of external swing check valve on CP-100 discharge spool.
steps.expected_observation: Bonnet gasket intact without scoring.

steps.instruction: Examine check valve hinge pin and torsion spring for wear or fracture.
steps.expected_observation: Hinge pin straight, disc swings smoothly without radial slop, return spring tension intact.

nodes.escalation_criteria: If hinge pin has > 0.5 mm wear groove, replace hinge pin and disc assembly.

nodes.title: DuraTorq IM-50-VFD Carrier Frequency & Grounding Ring Audit
nodes.required_expertise: Certified VFD Specialist / Electrical Tech III
safety_precautions: Wait 10 minutes after VFD main breaker opened for DC bus capacitor bank discharge (< 50 VDC)
Verify DC bus voltage with multimeter before touching drive terminals
stop_work_conditions: DC bus voltage reads > 50 V after 10 minute bleed-down
Inverter IGBT module shows visible scorch mark or swelling

steps.instruction: Access VFD parameter group P-04 (Carrier Frequency) and verify setting is configured to exactly 4.0 kHz.
steps.expected_observation: Parameter P-04 displays 4.0 kHz (not 8.0 or 12.0 kHz).
steps.caution: Do not set carrier frequency above 4.0 kHz without sine-wave filter.

steps.instruction: Inspect shaft grounding carbon brush or Aegis microfiber ring on drive end.
steps.expected_observation: Brush microfibers making clean 360-degree contact with polished copper shaft collar.

nodes.escalation_criteria: If fluting marks detected on bearing raceways, replace bearing with ceramic-hybrid insulated bearing.

nodes.title: 1000V Megohmmeter Motor Stator Insulation Resistance Test
safety_precautions: Disconnect motor leads from MCC drive/starter to avoid damaging electronic protection cards
Discharge windings to ground after test for at least 4 times the test duration
stop_work_conditions: Moisture or conductive water standing inside motor terminal head

steps.instruction: Apply 1000V DC test voltage between Phase U and Motor Ground for 60 seconds.
steps.expected_observation: Insulation resistance reading > 100 Megaohms (minimum acceptable 5 Megaohms).

steps.instruction: Repeat test for Phase V-to-Ground and Phase W-to-Ground.
steps.expected_observation: All three phases within 10% balanced resistance.

nodes.escalation_criteria: Insulation resistance below 5.0 Megaohms requires oven bake-out or motor rewinding.

nodes.title: Bearing Housing Flush and Relubrication Standard Procedure
safety_precautions: Allow bearing housing to cool below 50°C before opening drain plug
Collect old grease/oil into designated hazardous waste container
stop_work_conditions: Brass cage flakes or magnetic particles in drained grease

steps.instruction: Remove bottom grease relief plug and clean port with brass wire probe.
steps.expected_observation: Drain path completely open.

steps.instruction: Inject 35 grams of synthetic polyurea grease (ISO VG 68) while shaft is rotated slowly by hand.
steps.expected_observation: Fresh grease emerges from relief port with clean consistency.
steps.caution: Do not overfill housing beyond 40% void volume.

steps.instruction: Run machine for 30 minutes uncoupled with relief plug removed to expel excess lubricant.
steps.expected_observation: Bearing temperature stabilizes below 70°C.

nodes.escalation_criteria: If temperature continues to climb past 85°C after relubrication, shut down and inspect bearing internal clearances.

nodes.name: Discharge Check Valve Hinge Pin & Torsion Spring

nodes.resolution_notes: Measured 0.062 mm radial clearance on non-drive end 7312 bearing. Replaced bearing pair and repacked grease. Vibration dropped from 8.2 mm/s to 1.8 mm/s.
Found suction strainer basket 60% choked with corrosion scale. Cleaned screen and restored NPSHa; crackling noise vanished.
Plan 11 flush orifice was clogged with pipe dope. Seal ran dry and scored stationary carbon face. Replaced cartridge seal and cleaned flush port.
Technician previously overfilled bearing with grease gun without opening relief plug. Drained excess grease; temp dropped from 94°C to 68°C.
ApexFlow CP-200 minimum flow bypass valve positioner had slipped to 15%. Re-calibrated bypass actuator to maintain 40% MCSF minimum, resolving 5x vane pass surge.
On CP-100, discharge check valve hinge pin was worn oval causing disc flutter. Replaced pin and spring; pressure needle stabilized.
Laser alignment revealed 0.14 mm angular misalignment between M-105 and P-102. Re-shimmed motor inboard feet; 2x vibration reduced by 80%.
Found 0.048 mm radial clearance on pump drive end bearing. Replaced with SKF 6312 C3 and confirmed alignment.
Discharge throttle valve failed open causing pump to run into runout (135% design gpm). Throttled discharge to duty point, current returned to 58 Amps.
Deflector flinger ring loose on shaft allowed seal leakage wash to penetrate bearing isolator. Replaced seal and installed new isolator labyrinth.
Flushed suction basket. Awaiting supervisor signoff.
Greased bearing. Needs thermal imaging confirmation.
Re-torqued suction flange bolts. Requires flow test verification.

nodes.title: Industrial Plant Emergency Isolation & Stop-Work Standard Operating Procedure

sections.title: Emergency Stop-Work & Lockout/Tagout Protocol
sections.content: MANDATORY STOP-WORK: If abnormal thermal signatures, burning odor, visible smoke, electrical arcing, or sudden mechanical shaft seizure is detected, the technician MUST immediately initiate emergency stop, de-energize breaker, and install Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) padlocks. Do not attempt diagnostic measurement while energized under active fault conditions. Immediately escalate to the Plant Electrical Supervisor.

sections.title: Hazardous Fluid Containment & Personal Protective Equipment
sections.content: For high-pressure hydrocarbon and chemical feed pumps, barrier fluid or process liquid leakage exceeding 5 drops per minute requires immediate containment tray placement and PPE Level C (chemical splash face shield and nitrile gloves).

nodes.title: ApexFlow CP-200 Centrifugal Feed Pump Maintenance Manual (Superseded)

sections.title: Obsolete Bearing Clearance Tolerances
sections.content: SUPERSEDED SPECIFICATION: Maximum radial bearing clearance was formerly 0.080 mm. This specification was found to allow excessive shaft whip under cavitation and has been rescinded.

nodes.title: ApexFlow CP-200 Centrifugal Heavy-Duty Feed Pump Operations & Maintenance Manual

sections.title: Pump Alignment & Dynamic Vibration Limits
sections.content: ApexFlow CP-200 requires laser coupling alignment within 0.05 mm angular and 0.03 mm radial offset. ISO 10816-3 overall vibration velocity must remain below 4.5 mm/s RMS in zone A/B. Vibration exceeding 7.1 mm/s RMS indicates severe mechanical unbalance or bearing degradation.

sections.title: Hydraulic Performance, Cavitation & NPSH Requirements
sections.content: Net Positive Suction Head required (NPSHr) is 3.2 meters at best efficiency point. Suction pressure dropping below 1.2 bar gauge results in cavitation bubble collapse against the first-stage impeller eye, characterized by popping/gravel rattling noise and hydraulic shock pulses.

sections.title: Mechanical Seal & API Plan 11 Flush Regulation
sections.content: Fitted with cartridge mechanical seal. API Plan 11 flush circulation delivers process fluid from discharge orifice back to seal chamber. Orifice blockage starves seal faces of lubrication, causing dry running, face scorch marks, and subsequent fluid leakage from the gland drain.

sections.title: Bearing Housing Maintenance & Active Clearances
sections.content: Equipped with deep-groove 6312 ball bearings (drive end) and paired angular contact 7312 bearings (non-drive end). Maximum allowable radial play is 0.038 mm (nominal 0.025 mm). Relubricate with synthetic ISO VG 68 polyurea grease every 2,000 operating hours. Overgreasing induces churning and temperatures above 85°C.

sections.title: Impeller Vane Pass Pressure Pulsation & Acoustic Resonance
sections.content: CP-200 5-vane impellers operating below 65% minimum continuous stable flow (MCSF) generate acoustic pressure pulsation at 5x running speed. If pulsation amplitude exceeds 1.5 bar peak-to-peak at the discharge nozzle, verify minimum flow bypass valve position and examine diffuser ring for erosion.

nodes.title: ApexFlow CP-100 Light Industrial Utility Pump Maintenance Guide

sections.title: General Construction & Belt Drive Overview
sections.content: ApexFlow CP-100 is an end-suction single-stage utility pump. Unlike CP-200, CP-100 incorporates an external spring-loaded swing check valve directly bolted to the discharge flange.

sections.title: Discharge Check Valve Flutter & Line Pulsation
sections.content: Discharge pressure pulsations on CP-100 models are predominantly caused by worn hinge pins or broken return springs in the discharge swing check valve, creating high-frequency disc chatter and gauge oscillation. Do not confuse with impeller acoustic resonance.

sections.title: Packing Gland & Component Seal Adjustments
sections.content: Component mechanical seal with external spring. Allow 10-15 drops per minute leakage during running-in; steady stream signifies cracked silicon carbide primary ring.

nodes.title: DuraTorq IM-50 3-Phase Squirrel Cage Induction Motor Technical Specification

sections.title: Electrical Safety, Voltage Unbalance & Winding Temperature
sections.content: DuraTorq IM-50 is a 37kW, 400V 50Hz, 4-pole Class F insulation motor. Phase-to-phase resistance must balance within 1.5%. Phase voltage unbalance exceeding 1% causes a 6% increase in winding temperature. RTD temperature trip setpoint is 130°C.

sections.title: Insulation Resistance Megohmmeter Testing
sections.content: Measure winding insulation resistance with 1000V DC Megger. Minimum acceptable insulation resistance at 40°C is 100 Megaohms. Values below 5 Megaohms indicate severe moisture ingress or winding insulation breakdown; do not re-energize.

sections.title: Motor Bearings, End-Shield Tolerances & Air Gap
sections.content: Drive-end bearing 6310 C3 clearance. Air gap uniformity between stator and rotor must be checked at 4 cardinal positions; deviation exceeding 10% indicates worn bearing bracket or bent rotor shaft.

nodes.title: DuraTorq IM-50-VFD Inverter-Duty Drive & Carrier Frequency Supplement

sections.title: PWM Carrier Frequency Harmonics & Shaft Voltage Discharge
sections.content: CRITICAL APPLICABILITY: This section applies solely to DuraTorq-IM50-VFD equipped with external inverter drives. High PWM carrier frequency (>8 kHz) induces common-mode shaft voltages causing electrical discharge machining (EDM) fluting across bearing raceways. Inspect carbon grounding brush and verify carrier setting.

nodes.title: ApexSeal Cartridge Mechanical Seal Technical Manual

sections.title: Cartridge Seal Face Materials & Leakage Limits
sections.content: Silicon carbide vs carbon stationary face. Any visible steady spray or continuous puddle indicates secondary O-ring degradation or primary face fracturing due to particulate intrusion.
